# Evidence Span

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EvidenceSpan>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

An anchored target span within a resource — a text quote, character position, fragment identifier, page, or generic locator. Generalized from the citation-selector model to serve both evidentiary claims and annotation targets. The selector properties ([`selectorTextQuote`](../properties/gmeow-selectorTextQuote.md), [`selectorTextPosition`](../properties/gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md), [`selectorPage`](../properties/gmeow-selectorPage.md), [`selectorLocator`](../properties/gmeow-selectorLocator.md)) are asserted on [`EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md) individuals and inherited by [`Selector`](gmeow-Selector.md) instances. No second selector model is minted ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EvidenceSpan`](gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
